newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss KOF indicators inch up 0.1 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Swiss KOF indicators inch up 0.1 pct in August.

text.p: Switzerland's KOF economic barometer, a measure of Swiss leading indicators, inched up 0.1 percent from the previous month for a year-on-year rise of 0.9 percent, the KOF institute at the Zurich Federal Technical College (ETH) said.
This compares with a 0.6 percent year-on-yar rise in July and a 0.5 percent rise in June.
Based on the continuous improvement of the index in the first half of the year, KOF assumes the Swiss economy will not worsen in the second half.

KOF said its individual indices showed activity in the building sector continuing to decline while orders in the machinery sector were improving. The employment outlook had worsened, while the monetary indicator had a slightly positive impact on the overall index.
